name: Image Generation
description: Create images from a prompt while working in a task, with the image generation of your ChatGPT plan.

disclosure: Connect uses the ChatGPT account signed in on this Mac. Octopus keeps no separate key for Image Generation.
Tasks you connect can create images from prompts. Prompts go to ChatGPT, and each image counts against your plan's image usage.
The image comes back only to the task that asked for it, which sees it and can describe or use it.
Image generation needs a paid ChatGPT plan. To use another account, sign in to ChatGPT with it in Octopus.
